## Conclusions
- **The 010 recipe transfers to S0 unchanged: 69.21 → 82.24 (+13.03 [+11.4, +14.7])** on RefCOCOg-LPCVC. The
  LPCVC sample goes 89.30 → 91.01 (noise-level). Nothing was tuned for S0 (same data, steps, lr, seed).
- S0 gains less than B (+13.0 vs +16.0) and ends 5.1 points below fine-tuned B (82.24 vs 87.34). The capacity gap
  matters more after fine-tuning than before it (2.1 points zero-shot).
- S0's MobileOne/RepMixer image tower was trained un-reparameterized with BatchNorm statistics frozen. `build()`
  loads the checkpoint and *then* reparameterizes, so the exported graph is the same 10 ms architecture as exp 004.
  The on-device check follows in exp 016.
- **Speed entry:** fine-tuned S0 beats the official baseline (63.19) by +19 points at ~10 ms, while fine-tuned B
  is the accuracy entry (87.34 at 17.7 ms).
